artworks.title: The Peasants Avenge Themselves
artworks.artist: Gerrit van Schagen after Jacques Callot
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a chaotic scene. A church with a bell tower is in the background, and there are many figures engaged in a tumultuous encounter. Trees frame the scene, and the lines in the etching convey movement. The color palette is monochrome. Closest to the viewer, individuals and animals are sprawled out. Combatants are wielding weapons among swirling smoke, and some figures are in the trees. Buildings are visible in the distance, and a figure hangs from a tree branch.

artworks.title: Distribution of Rewards
artworks.artist: Gerrit van Schagen after Jacques Callot
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a figure seated on a throne, surrounded by an assembly of figures. The central element is a crowned figure on an elevated throne, within an architectural setting implying an interior space. To the left and right, a group of figures are gathered, some holding long objects and others gesturing or conversing. The detailed lines and shading suggest depth in the drawing, evoking a gathering in a grand hall or court. The image resembles classical European etchings with intricate linework and a historical storytelling style.

artworks.title: Daniel in the Lions' Den
artworks.artist: Willem van der Leeuw after Sir Peter Paul Rubens

artworks.title: God the Father and Angels Adoring the Christ Child
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20.6 x 40.3 cm (8 1/8 x 15 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial scene with angels and radiant figures. The composition features a group of angels on the left side, with two childish angels holding a scroll above them. There are heavenly figures among the clouds on the right, with rays of light emanating toward the center. The scene includes a large, swirling mass of clouds and drapery. On the lower center, textures of blankets and bundles suggest a resting area. In the lower portion, there is a detailed foreground with plants and possibly a basket or container. The delicate cross-hatching and lines give the drawing a rich depth of texture and atmosphere.

artworks.title: Italian Landscape (Paysage d'Italie)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with textured brushstrokes. The horizon is low in the composition with a small figure or structure in the distance against the sky. The sky has swirling, circular clouds while the foreground has dark, dense lines suggesting grass or trees. The monochromatic palette is dominated by warm sepia tones.

artworks.title: In Front of the Watteaus in the Louvre
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from behind, capturing her from head to toe. She is seen leaning slightly forward, seemingly focused on examining framed artworks on the wall in front of her. Her hair is styled neatly in an updo, though her facial features are not visible due to her positioning. The woman is wearing a long, flowing dress with puffed sleeves, cinched at the waist, and showcasing a detailed, textured fabric. She is holding a long parasol or umbrella in one hand. The background features a wall adorned with several framed pictures, which appear to be sketches or drawings, as well as ornate decorative elements below them, indicating an interior setting with an artistic or gallery-like vibe.

artworks.title: The Tuileries (Les Tuileries)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures standing along a fence with a view beyond. The figures are depicted with loose, expressive lines, and are seen from behind or at slight angles, facing what appears to be an open space or possibly an arena. The individuals hold or place their arms gently on the fence and one appears to be pointing or gesturing. The trees' canopy with minimal leaves extends over them in the upper left section of the drawing. The texture and shading techniques give the drawing a sketch-like quality, capturing a moment of observation or anticipation.

artworks.title: Moenippvs (Moenippus)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in profile, facing right. They have a long nose, full beard, and shoulder-length wavy hair. The person wears layered heavy clothing, including a robe, mantle, and wide-brimmed hat. Next to them is a jug on a pedestal and a scroll on the ground. The background has drawn textures.

artworks.title: Pancraz von Freyberg Hohenschau
artworks.description: The image depicts a half-length portrait of a seated man, slightly turned to the viewer's right. He has a long beard, mustache, a high forehead with deep-set eyes, and pronounced eyebrows. His hair is covered by a soft, pleated cap. The man is dressed in a textured garment with patterns and embellishments, including a chain around his neck. In the background, there is a decorative curtain on the left and a pair of ornate coats of arms on the right. The coat of arms includes symbols surrounded by decorative foliage. Below the portrait, there is a decorative border with an inscription.

artworks.title: Janus Lutma Posteritati (Jan Lutma the Elder)
artworks.description: The image shows a bust of a man from the shoulders up, facing slightly to his left. He has an aged face with pronounced facial features, including prominent cheekbones and deep-set eyes. His hair is curly, full, and flows backward from his forehead, and he has a full, curly beard and mustache. The man's clothing is not distinctly detailed, appearing to be a draped garment. The bust is against a plain, darkly shaded background that highlights the facial features. The base of the bust is inscribed with the name "IANUS LUTMA." Latin text gives information about the person's age and year of death.

artworks.title: Three Oriental Figures
artworks.description: The image portrays three individuals in a line from left to right. The person on the left is in profile view, facing right. Their hair is tied up in a turban-like shape. They wear layered clothing with long sleeves. Their hands are raised, gesturing towards the middle figure. The central figure is in profile facing left, with exaggerated facial features, and a large turban. They wear an ornate garment with fur trimming. The person on the right is in profile facing left, with facial hair and a wrapped turban. Their attire includes a shirt with rolled-up sleeves. The background is plain with an aged texture.

artworks.title: Choral
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines and curvilinear shapes creating an abstract design. Some shapes resemble figures clad in flowing garments at the top, while lines extend downward. The lower portion contains bold, dark shapes forming a textured area. The word "Choral" is inscribed near the bottom.

artworks.title: Corner of the Rue Royale (Coin de la rue royale)
artworks.description: The image shows a Parisian street scene with a woman in elaborate attire sitting at a cafe table, a bustling city street with people and a horse-drawn carriage, a signpost with a figure nearby, grand architectural columns, and a monochromatic color palette with detailed etching techniques illustrating the scene.

artworks.title: Gathering of May-lily (La cueillette du muguet)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a forest scene with figures collecting plants. The image shows several figures in a forest setting, with a foreground figure picking flowers or herbs. The detailed line work depicts the textures of the foliage, trees, and grass. In the background, other figures are also gathering plants. The dense line work and naturalistic depiction suggest movement and life within the scene, blending the figures with their environment.

artworks.title: Pier at Bercy (Embarcadere a Bercy)
artworks.description: The image depicts a waterfront scene with people relaxing on a stone embankment on the left. In the background, there is a busy boardwalk or promenade with figures walking around small structures and a dock. Various boats are on or near the water, and in the distance, buildings and a bridge with arches can be seen. The artwork is detailed with fine linework, using parallel and crosshatching strokes for texture and shading. The color scheme is monochromatic, with black ink on a beige background, highlighting the contrast between light and shadow.

artworks.title: Rouen
artworks.description: The image consists of several illustrations depicting different scenes. One segment shows a riverside with people on a bench overlooking the water. The skyline features tall buildings and a cloudy sky. In another part, there is a tower surrounded by boats, and below, a busy port with boats and city structures in the distance. The final illustration presents a riverside village with buildings and sailboats on the water. The artwork uses detailed linework and a monochromatic color scheme of grey and black.

artworks.title: Dedication Page
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a busy port with ships and buildings. The horizon, marked by the masts of the ships, is central. Flags feature prominently, with a large one at the center. Detailed line work with a cross-hatch technique defines textures and forms. The color palette is monochromatic, in sepia tones. In the foreground, iron railings and foliage are seen, leading to the waterfront with ships and buildings lining a street. The cityscape extends into the distance.

artworks.title: Dedication Page
artworks.description: The image shows a scene of a busy port from a slightly elevated angle. Ships are docked to the left, a train engine runs along the waterfront, and colorful flowers spill over a balcony railing on the right. In the distance, ship masts, sails, and smokestacks can be seen, along with a swaying flag. The artwork is detailed, featuring fine linework and a limited color palette that highlights the vibrant flowers.

artworks.title: Dedication Page
artworks.description: The illustration depicts a bustling port scene viewed from an elevated standpoint. The horizon is obscured by ships and buildings extending into the distance. Sailing ships and steam-powered vessels are prominent, reflecting a technological transition. The intricate style features precise lines conveying movement, with smoke and steam from ships and trains depicted. The primarily monochrome palette is occasionally accentuated with red-orange tones. Selective coloring highlights specific elements, like the flowers. A large flag, potentially the French tricolor, cuts across the scene. Buildings, streets, and crowds are shown, adding depth to the environment.

artworks.title: Preface
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a written passage by Roger Marx dated 3 November 1900, praising illustration work related to "Nantes in 1900," particularly highlighting artist Lepère. The text is in a serif typeface. To the right, there is a line drawing depicting an architectural setting with figures, a staircase, and arches, suggesting a lively scene in an interior venue. The architectural details and figures are sketched in a loose yet precise style, depicting bustling activity or a social gathering.

artworks.title: Woman on the Road (La femme sur la route)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with drypoint [posthumous impression]
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from a raised vantage point. The horizon is high in the composition, bordered by rolling hills. The sky features expressive clouds. The color palette is mainly sepia or gray. A pathway extends inward surrounded by textured surfaces. A small figure is on the path, looking towards the distant hills. The brushstrokes vary in texture, with stippling and smoother areas creating depth.

artworks.title: The Temptation of Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures facing each other in a rural landscape. The scene is rich with detailed line work, depicting one figure dressed in flowing robes and the other adorned with armor and wings. The robed figure holds a book, while the winged figure features fantastical elements like a spiraling tail. Both figures are standing on a grassy terrain, surrounded by lush foliage and under a partly cloudy sky. In the background, a small settlement can be seen amidst rolling hills. The intricate cross-hatching and attention to detail are emblematic of the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: View of the River Rhine
artworks.artist: Jan van Aken after Herman Saftleven
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape seen from an elevated point, featuring mountainous terrain. The horizon is obscured by rocky peaks, creating depth. The scene is depicted in an engraved style with detailed lines. The color scheme is black and white, emphasizing contrasts. A winding path with travelers is seen near a tree. A river leads towards mountains under a cloudy sky.
